## Summary

Review follow-up to #6004 ([comment](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/pull/6004#discussion_r4445301638)): since #6004 made the "while parsing" part of the parser's syntax error message unconditional, the three appends at the start of `exception_message()` are one fixed string around the context. They are now a single `concat("syntax error while parsing ", context, " - ")`. The message text is unchanged.

## Breaking changes

No breaking changes. The change is internal and every error message stays byte-for-byte the same.

title: Build the parser's syntax error prefix with one concat()
